description: Known, justified exceptions to tools/check-architecture.mjs. Every entry needs a reason; entries that no longer match a violation fail the check. See docs/ENFORCEMENT.md. Format: recoveredRuntime and crossFeature entries are { "from": "assets/src/app/...", "to": "assets/src/...", "reason": "..." }; cycles entries are { "files": [ "assets/src/app/...", ... ], "reason": "..." }; rawColours entries are { "file": "assets/src/app/...", "value": "#rrggbb", "reason": "..." }; sharedHooks entries are { "file": "assets/src/app/features/...", "hook": "usePagedList", "reason": "..." }.

rawColours.reason: Example value in the translated help text of the learner branding colour fields; it is shown as text, not used as a colour.
